name: Plank Cutter
summary: Cut every kind of plank into stairs, slabs, doors and more in the stonecutter, one plank at a time and without waste.
logoPrompt: A stonecutter block with its round saw blade spinning, cutting a stack of warm wooden planks into a neat little wooden staircase, wood shavings flying, in blocky voxel style

cover.tagline: Wood blocks straight from the stonecutter.

description: **Plank Cutter lets the stonecutter work with wood: put in planks and pick the wooden block you need, one plank at a time.**
- Stairs, slabs, fences, fence gates, doors, trapdoors and pressure plates from a single plank.
- Works for oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark oak, mangrove, cherry, pale oak, bamboo, crimson and warped planks.
- One plank gives two slabs or one of everything else, close to what the crafting table gives.
- The crafting table recipes stay as they are.
Import the .mcpack, then turn it on under Behavior Packs when you create or edit a world. Place a stonecutter and put planks into it.
- Made for Minecraft Bedrock 26.60 and newer. It only adds recipes, so it is safe to add to or remove from an existing world.
- Like any behavior pack it can be used in singleplayer, on Realms and on servers; it needs no experimental features.
- Like every behavior pack, it turns off achievements in the world it is added to.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
